candidates.name: OfficeBench
candidates.scope: 300 multi-application office workflow tasks; Excel/Word/PowerPoint and other office applications
leakage_risks: task files and evaluation answers may be bundled with source
third-party Office content and application dependencies
candidates.notes: README describes task annotations and evaluation methods but does not provide a separate data license statement.

candidates.name: SpreadsheetBench
candidates.scope: 912 real-world spreadsheet instructions and 2,729 test cases; sample release contains 200 data points
candidates.data_license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (README statement; file-level provenance still required)
leakage_risks: questions derived from public Excel forums
source workbooks may contain third-party or personal content
answer workbooks can leak hidden targets
candidates.notes: Best first candidate for an Excel sub-study only after checking the release archive and workbook-level terms.

candidates.name: OSWorld
candidates.scope: Open-ended computer-use tasks in real desktop environments; Office-related subsets may be selected
candidates.notes: Apache-2.0 repository badge covers the code repository; it is not treated as blanket permission for all assets.

candidates.name: Windows Agent Arena
candidates.scope: Windows 11 desktop benchmark platform with VM images and application tasks
candidates.notes: Not selected for the first formal dataset; requires a separate Windows/Office environment and terms review.

candidates.name: SpreadsheetBench 2
leakage_risks: business documents and confidential-looking spreadsheet content
candidates.notes: Keep as a future adapter target only; do not download into the formal dataset.
